interpretation: SKR group differences are descriptively real but not temporally stable enough for a rolling point correction.
The correction overreacts to prior group residuals and often flips the sign of bias.
C7 and C8 descriptive overprediction should therefore be treated as an error-profile/uncertainty signal, not a deterministic forecast adjustment.
Population/reliability remains the stronger complementary hypothesis.
next_recommended_step: Use SKR and demographic structure for uncertainty calibration and reporting, not point correction; retain core4 as baseline and population blend as research challenger only.
